effect_description_eng: [On Play] [When Digivolving] 1 of your Digimon gains ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.) until the end of your opponent's turn.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When an effect plays one of your Digimon, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.)
